TV Actor Aditi Sharma Files Domestic Violence FIR Against Husband, In-Laws

Television actor Aditi Sharma has filed a First Information Report (FIR) in Mumbai against her husband and in-laws. Sharma has accused them of domestic violence, physical and mental abuse, and harassment. The FIR also includes allegations that her mother-in-law and sister-in-law kept her jewelry. Police have initiated an investigation into the matter.
